meta.title: Riveto store demo
meta.description: Riveto theme + Store Kit + WooCommerce with 12 sample products
meta.author: Riveto

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// ---- Edit this: your WhatsApp number (e.g. 03001234567). Leave empty to hide WhatsApp buttons.
$whatsapp = '';

wp_set_current_user( 1 );

// Store basics: Pakistan, PKR, no decimals, Karachi time, pretty links, skip the setup wizard.
foreach ( array(
	'woocommerce_default_country'           => 'PK',
	'woocommerce_currency'                  => 'PKR',
	'woocommerce_price_num_decimals'        => 0,
	'woocommerce_allowed_countries'         => 'specific',
	'woocommerce_specific_allowed_countries'=> array( 'PK' ),
	'woocommerce_ship_to_countries'         => '',
	'woocommerce_coming_soon'               => 'no',
	'woocommerce_onboarding_profile'        => array( 'skipped' => true ),
	'woocommerce_task_list_hidden'          => 'yes',
	'woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout'     => 'yes',
	'woocommerce_manage_stock'              => 'yes',
	'timezone_string'                       => 'Asia/Karachi',
	'blogname'                              => 'Riveto',
	'blogdescription'                       => '',
) as $k => $v ) {
	update_option( $k, $v );
}
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );

// Shop, cart, checkout and account pages, with the classic cart and checkout Store Kit needs.
WC_Install::create_pages();
foreach ( array( 'cart' => '[woocommerce_cart]', 'checkout' => '[woocommerce_checkout]' ) as $page => $code ) {
	$id = wc_get_page_id( $page );
	if ( $id > 0 ) {
		wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $id, 'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->' . $code . '<!-- /wp:shortcode -->' ) );
	}
}

// Cash on delivery on.
update_option( 'woocommerce_cod_settings', array( 'enabled' => 'yes', 'title' => 'Cash on delivery', 'description' => 'Pay with cash when your parcel arrives.', 'instructions' => '', 'enable_for_methods' => array(), 'enable_for_virtual' => 'yes' ) );

// Store Kit settings.
update_option( 'store_kit_options', Store_Kit::sanitize( array_merge( Store_Kit::defaults(), array( 'whatsapp' => $whatsapp ) ) ) );

// Delivery: Rs 250 flat, free over Rs 5,000.
if ( ! WC_Shipping_Zones::get_zones() ) {
	$zone = new WC_Shipping_Zone();
	$zone->set_zone_name( 'Pakistan' );
	$zone->add_location( 'PK', 'country' );
	$zone->save();
	$i = $zone->add_shipping_method( 'flat_rate' );
	update_option( "woocommerce_flat_rate_{$i}_settings", array( 'title' => 'Delivery', 'cost' => '250', 'tax_status' => 'none' ) );
	$j = $zone->add_shipping_method( 'free_shipping' );
	update_option( "woocommerce_free_shipping_{$j}_settings", array( 'title' => 'Free delivery', 'requires' => 'min_amount', 'min_amount' => '5000' ) );
}

// 12 sample products from the CSV.
if ( file_exists( '/tmp/riveto-products.csv' ) && ! wc_get_products( array( 'limit' => 1, 'return' => 'ids' ) ) ) {
	include_once WC_ABSPATH . 'includes/import/class-wc-product-csv-importer.php';
	include_once WC_ABSPATH . 'includes/admin/importers/class-wc-product-csv-importer-controller.php';
	$file     = '/tmp/riveto-products.csv';
	$raw      = new WC_Product_CSV_Importer( $file, array( 'parse' => false, 'lines' => -1 ) );
	$headers  = $raw->get_raw_keys();
	$ctrl     = new WC_Product_CSV_Importer_Controller();
	$auto     = new ReflectionMethod( $ctrl, 'auto_map_columns' );
	$auto->setAccessible( true );
	$importer = new WC_Product_CSV_Importer( $file, array( 'parse' => true, 'lines' => -1, 'mapping' => array( 'from' => $headers, 'to' => $auto->invoke( $ctrl, $headers ) ) ) );
	$importer->import();
}

delete_option( 'rewrite_rules' );
flush_rewrite_rules( false );
wc_delete_product_transients();
